A FEW USEFUL DETAILS

Good to know
before you begin.

A clear picture of what’s here,
and what comes next.

See what changed ↗
Which computers can run SnapNote?+

This preview download is for Windows 10/11 on x64 computers. The desktop workflow has been tested on Windows and Linux. A macOS version has not been validated for this preview.

Can I use it without an internet connection?+

Yes. Clipboard history, search, notes, image tools and backups work locally. You don’t need an account. The installer may need an internet connection to install Microsoft WebView2 if it is missing.

How does text extraction from images work?+

SnapNote uses Tesseract on your computer. Install Tesseract and its language data separately, make it available on your system PATH, and restart SnapNote. Then choose an image and select Extract text. The current installer does not bundle Tesseract. Tesseract installation information ↗

Is my workspace encrypted automatically?+

Encryption is optional. Enable it in Settings & privacy and choose a password. Backups have their own optional password. There is no password recovery, so keep your passwords safe. Locking hides the workspace and closes pins; it does not erase your operating system’s clipboard.

Will it keep my existing SnapNote notes?+

The redesign reuses the existing app and migrates legacy notes into the new workspace. Rich formatting, image paste and original capture shortcuts remain available. Export a backup before trying a preview on important data.

Does it sync between devices?+

Sync is not available in this preview. Your workspace stays on this device. You can export and import backups to move saved content yourself. Optional sync is a possible later phase.
